description: Fetch one public HTML page and return what is actually on it: final URL, status code, redirect count, title, meta description, canonical, meta robots, html lang, H1 texts, heading counts, JSON-LD @types, word count and HTML size. No rule verdicts — call check_url for those, or audit_url to diff against the site's last completed run. Use it to look before you decide, or to see what a change actually shipped. Requires the audit:read scope and counts one network fetch.

url.description: Public http(s) URL to fetch. Private hosts and non-HTML responses are rejected.

name: fetch_page
title: Fetch one page and return its SEO facts
